title: EpiExposure: An epidemiological workflow for DLNM interpretation
text: Distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs) widely used quantify exposure–lag–response associations. However, applied epidemiological studies require additional methodological structure support interpretation, including biologically meaningful exposure windows standardised summaries. EpiExposure package provides structured framework bridge statistical estimation epidemiological interpretation.

title: DLNM Tools for Epidemiological Exposure Analysis
text: EpiExposure R package provides epidemiological framework structuring, summarising, interpreting exposure–lag–response associations fitted using Distributed Lag Non-Linear Models (DLNMs). package designed work top dlnm package, adding domain-specific structure required epidemiological studies, particularly plant disease epidemiology climate–disease research. dlnm offers flexible statistical infrastructure modelling exposure–lag–response relationships, EpiExposure formalises epidemiological decisions, exposure windows biologically meaningful summaries, typically implemented ad hoc manner.

title: DLNM Tools for Epidemiological Exposure Analysis
text: EpiExposure replace dlnm redefine statistical methodology. Instead, provides: Explicit definition epidemiological exposure windows Standardised workflows cumulative window-specific effects Clear separation model fitting epidemiological interpretation Reproducible summaries aligned biological cycles (e.g. crop development) short: dlnm answers estimate. EpiExposure answers interpret epidemiologically.
